collate_tokens: create a padded 2d tensor from a list of 1d tensors with configurable padding and EOS handling
load_indexed_dataset: load an indexed dataset from a file path with optional combining of multiple datasets
numpy_seed: seed the NumPy random number generator within a context manager and restore state afterward
batch_by_size: yield mini-batches of dataset indices bucketed by token count with configurable max tokens and sentences
post_process: post-process a tokenized sentence by removing subword symbols for sentencepiece wordpiece or letter models
